Usage: zealakit create [options] [project-name]

Create a new project. Modes: interactive prompts, --discover (recommendations),
or --template <id>.

Arguments:
  project-name               Project name (npm naming rules)

Options:
  -t, --template <template>  Choose a base template yourself (default:
                             vite-react). Available: vite-react, vite-vue,
                             vite-svelte, astro-react-client,
                             astro-react-hybrid, next, nuxt, nest, hono,
                             fastapi-api, python-worker, stdlib-api, gin-api,
                             stdlib-worker
  -w, --with <recipes>       Recipes to apply, comma-separated (e.g. biome).
                             Available: biome, eslint, zustand, pinia,
                             nanostores, client-shared-pieces, hookform-zod,
                             vee-validate-zod, kyjs, axios, tanstack-query,
                             antd, mui, shadcn-ui, nuxt-ui, shadcn-vue,
                             storybook, vitest, docker, better-auth, nest-auth,
                             github-actions, type-orm, mikro-orm, drizzle-orm,
                             prisma, sqlalchemy, alembic, postgres-python,
                             docker-python, github-actions-python, postgres,
                             mysql, mongodb, docker-go, github-actions-go,
                             goose, sqlc, redis
  -y, --yes                  Non-interactive: never prompt; refuses a non-empty
                             target
  --force                    Overwrite a non-empty target directory without
                             asking
  --dry-run                  Resolve and validate without writing files
  --pm <manager>             Package manager for install and next steps: npm,
                             pnpm, yarn, bun (default: detected)
  --install                  Install dependencies after generating (go mod tidy
                             for Go)
  --no-install               Do not install dependencies
  --git                      Run git init and make an initial commit
  --no-git                   Do not initialize a git repository
  --no-manifest              Do not write zealakit.json into the project
  --config <file>            Config file with `defaults` and `presets` (highest
                             precedence over project/user config)
  --stack <members>          Create a workspace of several apps, e.g.
                             web=next,api=hono (recipes: -w web:mui,api:prisma)
  --trust-external           Apply external (path or github:) recipes without
                             asking; required with -y or --json
  --preset <name>            Apply a saved preset (see `zealakit preset list`);
                             flags override it
  --save-preset <name>       Save the chosen template and recipes as a user
                             preset
  --discover                 Project Discovery: answer a few questions and get
                             template/recipe recommendations
  --json                     Machine-readable output: with --discover read one
                             JSON request from stdin; otherwise non-interactive
                             (needs -y, -w, --preset or --dry-run) and print one
                             JSON result on stdout
  -h, --help                 display help for command
